faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGCU JRF/Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the MGCU JRF/Project Fellow positions is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics or Chemistry with at least 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA. Research interest in specific areas is also required.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF/Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for the JRF/Project Fellow post ranges from Rs. 14,000/- per month (without NET/GATE) to Rs. 25,000/- per month (with NET/GATE).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MGCU JRF/Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, and send it along with required documents via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview and document verification. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for these stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this MGCU recruitment is UFR-75325.

faq.question: Q8. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Mahatma Gandhi Central University (MGCU).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the JRF/Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The JRF/Project Fellow position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Mahatma Gandhi Central University located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi Central University is located in Motihari, Bihar, with the pincode 845401.
